$comment: Compact roster. Carries no authored strings by design — no kami names, no account name — so its untrusted path list is always empty and the answer is identical in name-free mode. Identities are indices. Full per-kami detail lives on the party query.

roomIndex.description: the room the account itself is standing in

room.description: §3.12 (enrich): roomIndex resolved. On roster, {index, name} only — the compact answer stays compact.

levelUpReady.description: §3.13: kami indices that can be levelled RIGHT NOW (enough experience AND resting). A SET on the account block, not a field on the kami rows: the roster's compaction guarantee is measured as marginal bytes PER KAMI (G7.a), and anything outside kamis[] cancels out of that measurement — so the marginal cost is unchanged at every roster composition, including the worst case. Numeric, so the empty-untrusted-list and name-free guarantees hold.

skillPoints.description: §3.13: [kamiIndex, unspentSkillPoints] for every kami holding any. Set form, for the reason above. Skill NAMES never appear on this answer.

hp.description: [current, total] — percent is the consumer's division

RoomRef.description: §3.12 (enrich): a room index resolved to its registry name and description. Present only when the daemon runs with enrich=true. An index the mirror has no room for keeps the index and answers with empty strings.
